about: Tender Tool's own discipline / category list - what discovered tenders are sorted into and what companies tag their experience with. NOT a fixed standard: Sarel, 2026-10-17: 'There is no standard list ... build our own list ... a list that we're gonna have to maintain and build.' Seeded 2026-10-17 from the real tenders on hand (2 211 live eTenders opportunities, 400 OCDS releases, the 11 general samples, the 6 SANRAL samples) cross-checked against eTenders.gov.za's own 91-entry category dropdown and Leads 2 Business's 17 tender categories. Evidence: docs/specs/Discipline-Taxonomy-Findings.md. The LIVE list is the discipline_categories table (migration 0038): add a category by inserting a row (engine/discovery/taxonomy.py add), no migration. This file is the seed and the offline fallback; engine/discovery/taxonomy.py sync pushes it to the table.
keyword_syntax: Lower-case phrase, matched on whole words after punctuation is turned into spaces; a trailing s/es plural also matches; a trailing * matches any word ending (rehabilitat* = rehabilitate, rehabilitation). 'exclude' phrases are removed from the text before that one category's keywords are tried (e.g. 'road accident fund' is a buyer name, not road works). 'a & b' needs every part present (school & construct*). An exclude starting with ! vetoes the whole category when present (a lease of premises at 'Ocean Road' is not road work).
